position_rules: No shared selectable hardware dictionary or length set. Match exact vendor/model/firmware/backup and derivation mode first.

external_secret.guidance: Any supported mnemonic passphrase stays outside Tessaveil; wallet login/spending passwords are distinct. Paper27 already includes its nine password words; no extra secret is inferred.

semantic_distinction: Icarus-Trezor and Ledger/BitBox02 differ, including Trezor 24 checksum-byte handling. Generic hardware label is blocked; SLIP39 device support does not prove Cardano derivation. No universal length/mapping asserted.
